caseNameFull: Sugden et ux. v. United States
attorneys: Mark Wilmer argued the cause for petitioners. With him on the brief was Frank L. Snell. John F. Davis argued the cause for the United States. With him on the brief were Solicitor General Sobeloff, Assistant Attorney General Olney, Beatrice Rosenberg and Carl H. Imlay.

opinions.text:
Certiorari, 350 U. S. 952, to the United States Court of Appeals for the Ninth Circuit. Decided April 30, 1956.

Per Curiam:

The judgment is affirmed.

Mr. Justice Black, Mr. Justice Frankfurter, and Mr. Justice Douglas dissent.
